parts.text: Which value of $B$ makes the addition true?
Give one reason for your choice that uses place value or a carry.

stem:
Chirag solves this digit-in-disguise addition. Each letter stands for one fixed digit from $0$ to $9$, and different letters stand for different digits.

$$\begin{array}{c@{}c@{}c} & 3 & B \\ + & B & 3 \\ \hline & 8 & 8 \end{array}$$

part_answers.answer: Units: B+3 gives ones digit 8, so B=5 with no carry. Tens: 3+B=8, which also holds for B=5.

teacher.key_rationale: Units B+3 ends in 8 forces B=5; tens 3+5=8 confirms. B=3 repeats a printed digit inconsistently with the sum; B=8 fails the units column.
